Title: Backend Engineer
Description:
Spektrum have a wide range of exciting opportunities in several global locations.  We are always looking to add great new talent to our team and look forward to hearing from you.

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting 

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

Role ID – C004966

Role Duties and Responsibilities

Devises and implements master data management processes for specific subsets of data.
Assesses the integrity of data from multiple sources.
Provides advice on the transformation of data from one format/medium to another.
Maintains and implements information handling procedures.
Enables the availability, integrity and searchability of information through the application of formal data and metadata structures and protection measures.
Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, amends and refactors moderately complex programs/scripts.
Applies agreed standards and tools to achieve a well- engineered result.
Monitors and reports on progress.
Identifies issues related to software development activities.
Proposes practical solutions to resolve issues.
Collaborates in reviews of work with others as appropriate.
Investigates enterprise data requirements where there is some complexity and ambiguity.
Plans own data modelling and design activities, selecting appropriate techniques and the correct level of detail for meeting assigned objectives.
Provides advice and guidance to others using the data structures and associated components.
Designs, implements, and maintains complex data engineering solutions to acquire and prepare data.
Creates and maintains data pipelines to connect data within and between data stores, applications and organisations.
Investigates the described problem and dataset to assess the usefulness of data science and analytics solutions.
Applies a range of data science techniques and uses specialised programming languages.
Understands and applies rules and guidelines specific to the industry, and anticipates risks and other implications of modelling.
Selects, acquires and integrates data for analysis.
Develops data hypotheses and methods and evaluates analytics models.
Advises on the effectiveness of specific techniques based on project findings and comprehensive research.
Contributes to the development, evaluation, monitoring and deployment of data science solutions.
Supports business intelligence needs of specific management or governance processes or operational areas.
Investigates the need for business intelligence reporting and analysis where there is some complexity and ambiguity.
Selects and applies non-standard business intelligence tools and techniques to provide insights and aid decision-making.
Selects, acquires and integrates data for analysis.
Identifies opportunities to digitise and streamline operational data handling and optimise business intelligence capabilities.
Applies a variety of visualisation techniques and designs the content and appearance of data visuals.
Operationalises and automates activities for efficient and timely production of data visuals.
Selects appropriate visualisation approaches from a range of applicable options.
Contributes to exploration and experimentation in data visualisation.
Evaluates design options and prototypes to obtain user feedback on requirements of developing systems, products, services or devices.
Tests the usability and accessibility of components and alternative designs.
Administers a range of evaluations, recording data and feedback.
Analyses evaluation data and recommends actions.
Identifies areas for future user research.
Checks systems, products, services or devices for adherence to applicable standards, guidelines, style guides, and legislation.
Evaluates the usability of existing or competitor systems to provide benchmark values and as input to design.

Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications

Demonstrable experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar role, or experience performing these functions roles as part of another job.
Demonstrable experience with at least one programminglanguage, such as Python, R, or C#.
Experience with commercially available or open source data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Grafana or R Shiny.
Experience with SQL and relational databases, such as SQL Server.
Experience with user experience KPIs and reporting.

Education

A minimum requirement of a relevant degree at a nationally recognised/certified University in a related discipline and 2 years post-related experience. Or exceptionally, the lack of a university degree may be compensated by the demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience that is/are of interest to NCI Agency, that is, at least 6 years extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to the function of the post.

Desirable

Prior experience of working in an international environment comprising both military and civilian elements;
Knowledge of NATO responsibilities and organization, including ACO and ACT.
ITIL Foundation, DevOps Foundation and certifications proving the competency level in programming/software development skills

Working Location

Braine-l’Alleud, Belgium

Working Policy

Onsite

Travel

Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

Security Clearance

Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

Title: Digital Data Specialist
Description:
Your purpose at Stanley/Stella




We’re looking for a Digital Data Specialist who will own and elevate our entire measurement ecosystem, turning raw data into clear, actionable insights that directly impact business decisions, customer journeys, and performance. You won’t just report numbers. You’ll challenge assumptions, uncover opportunities and influence strategy across marketing, ecommerce and digital products.

You are the bridge between data, business and experience.




Your role and impact




1. Tracking & Data Governance

Ensure data is accurate, structured and compliant across all touchpoints.

Own tracking across website, webshop, marketing tools and future products.
Design data layer, event taxonomy & tracking specs.
Manage tagging (Piwik PRO / GA / GTM): events, ecommerce, pixels, UTMs, paid media.
Validate implementations & run audits (quality, consistency, GDPR, CMP).
Monitor scripts & impact on Core Web Vitals.




2. Reporting & Business Insights

Turn data into decision-making tools, not just dashboards.

Build Power BI reporting (DAX, Power Query, AI).
Define & align KPIs: performance, acquisition, funnels, retention, campaigns, AI visibility
Structure robust data models for consistent tracking.
Support business reviews with clear insights (risks, opportunities, actions).
Enable self-service analytics with strong governance.
Translate complex data into simple, business-driven narratives




3. Customer Journey Analysis, CRO & Optimisation

Identify friction and unlock growth.

Analyse journeys & funnels (Hotjar, Clarity, Mouseflow).
Detect drop-offs & optimisation opportunities.
Support A/B testing, personalisation & CRO.
Partner with teams to turn insights into measurable improvements.




4. Performance Monitoring & Product Analytics

Connect performance, usage and product evolution.

Monitor website performance (Core Web Vitals, RumVision) with IT.
Analyse product usage & feature adoption.
Contribute to event-based / product analytics evolution.
Support data-driven, AI-enabled experiences.




5. Market Intelligence

Bring an external, forward-looking perspective.

Benchmark competitors (traffic, pricing, UX, visibility) via scraping & tools.
Track trends: AI-driven discovery, search evolution.
Explore AI analytics: anomaly detection, predictive insights




6. Cross-functional Collaboration & Data Culture

Be the go-to expert for analytics.

Translate business needs into measurable solutions.
Work cross-functionally (Marketing, Product, BI, IT)
Improve UTM discipline, measurement quality, analytics maturity
Drive a strong data-driven culture




About you




Must-have

Strong experience: Piwik PRO / GA / GTM + GDPR / CMP
Solid knowledge: web analytics, ecommerce, event tracking , conversion
Experience designing data layers & tracking specs
Strong Power BI (DAX, Power Query)
UX analytics tools (Hotjar, Clarity…)
Experience in CRO / AB testing
Web scraping (Python or tools)
Sharp analytical + clear communicator




Nice to have

SQL / Big Query
Core Web Vitals / performance optimisation
Ecommerce / digital product environment




What Success Looks Like

Data is accurate, compliant and trusted
Conversion opportunities are identified & activated
Reporting becomes predictive and actionable
A real data culture is embedded

Description:
Als Schweizer Tochtergesellschaft des weltweit tätigen B. Braun-Konzerns gehören wir zu den Marktführern in der Schweiz und bieten unseren über 1’100 Mitarbeitenden spannende Perspektiven. Möchten Sie aktiv zur datengetriebenen Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens beitragen? In dieser vielseitigen Rolle gestalten Sie in einem interdisziplinären Team moderne Reporting- und Analytics-Lösungen und treiben die Automatisierung von Prozessen voran.

Description:
Data Analyst (Customer & Marketing Analytics)

📍 Lugano | Hybrid Working Model | Permanent Position

About the Company

Our client is a well-established financial services institution operating in Switzerland and committed to leveraging data-driven insights to enhance customer experience, digital engagement and business performance.

To support the continued development of its analytics capabilities, we are looking for a Data Analyst (Customer & Marketing Analytics) to join a dynamic and collaborative team based in Lugano.

This role offers a unique opportunity to combine data analytics, business intelligence, customer insights and predictive modelling within a modern and innovative environment.

Your Mission

As a Data Analyst, you will help transform customer and business data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

Working closely with Marketing, Digital and Business teams, you will contribute to customer segmentation, behavioural analysis, campaign performance measurement and predictive modelling initiatives aimed at optimizing customer engagement and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Analyse customer behaviour, product usage and customer journeys across multiple channels and touchpoints.
Develop customer segmentation and profiling models using demographic, transactional and behavioural data.
Build and maintain predictive models to support business and marketing initiatives.
Extract, manipulate and analyse data from multiple sources using SQL and Python.
Design and automate recurring reporting processes and analytical workflows.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence dashboards and performance reports.
Monitor customer portfolio KPIs and identify actionable business insights.
Collaborate with Marketing and Digital teams to support customer acquisition, retention and engagement strategies.
Ensure data quality, consistency and integrity across reporting and analytical processes.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.

Your Profile

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a related discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics or a similar analytical role.
Strong experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Advanced SQL knowledge.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Practical experience with:
Pandas
NumPy
Scikit-Learn
Experience in statistical analysis, forecasting, customer segmentation or predictive modelling.
Advanced Excel skills.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-driven, proactive and business-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have

Experience within banking, financial services, fintech, payments or credit card environments.
Knowledge of Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI.
Experience with BigQuery, SPSS or similar analytical platforms.
Exposure to machine learning techniques and customer behavioural modelling.
Experience supporting marketing, CRM or customer engagement initiatives.

Languages

Mandatory

Italian – Fluent
English – Fluent
German – Professional proficiency

What’s on Offer

Permanent position within a stable and growing financial services organization.
Hybrid working model.
Exposure to customer analytics, predictive modelling and business intelligence projects.
Collaborative and international working environment.
Modern data and analytics ecosystem.
Long-term career growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about analytics, customer insights and transforming data into business value, we would be delighted to hear from you.

URGENT ****




We are looking for an Data Analyst to join our teams and support Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T) and Validation activities within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. The successful candidate will contribute to data management, process improvement, validation support, and documentation activities while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and support operational excellence across technical and manufacturing functions.




Your responsibilities




Support the setup, maintenance, and validation of STATISTICA workspaces used for automated analysis of data from systems such as LIMS and MES.
Verify data integrity and ensure the accuracy and reliability of data analyses and reporting activities.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support technical operations and project objectives.
Ensure compliance with GMP standards, internal procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Actively contribute to workplace safety by adhering to safety procedures and identifying potential risks or hazards.
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to quality, compliance, and operational performance.




Your profile




Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biology, Chemistry, or another relevant scientific discipline.
0–3 years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related Life Sciences industry.
Previous exposure to GMP-regulated environments is considered a strong advantage.
Understanding of manufacturing, validation, technical operations, or process engineering activities.
Experience working with data analysis tools and systems such as LIMS, MES, or statistical software is desirable.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to process, interpret, and report technical data accurately.
Experience maintaining controlled documentation, SOPs, and quality records.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

Title: Process & Data Analyst (w/m/d)
Description:
Als führende Schweizer E-Commerce-Plattform, mit einem Team von über 4’000 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Serbien, sind wir auf dem Weg in neue Märkte. Unser Motor dafür ist der Wille, Bestehendes immer wieder neu zu denken. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft daran arbeiten, Dinge wirklich besser zu machen. Bei uns findest du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, mit uns zu wachsen und dabei ganz du selbst zu sein. Handle galaktisch. Und bleib du.




Die Logistik von Digitec Galaxus wächst rasant: neue Lager, neue Prozesse, neue Massstäbe. Hinter jedem Paket, das pünktlich ankommt, stecken hunderte operative Entscheidungen – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Unser Continuous-Improvement-Team (CI) optimiert die Abläufe in allen unseren Lagerstandorten. Was uns noch fehlt, ist eine datengetriebene Stimme im Team: jemand, der mit Process Mining und Datenanalyse aufzeigt, wo die grössten Hebel liegen, wie gross der Impact sein kann und ob Verbesserungen nachhaltig wirken. Gleichzeitig hebst du die Datenkompetenz des gesamten CI-Teams auf das nächste Level.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem zentralen Data Team zusammen, definierst Datenanforderungen für die Pipeline und entwickelst eigenständig Dashboards und Reports, die den operativen Teams helfen, die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen.




Deine Aufgaben




Mithilfe unseres internen Process-Mining-Tools, SQL und Dashboarding-Tools identifizierst du standortübergreifend Schwachstellen und Verbesserungspotenziale in unseren Lagerprozessen
Du entwickelst fundierte Business Cases für Verbesserungsinitiativen, quantifizierst den erwarteten Impact und bewertest Kosten und Nutzen
Anhand von Daten überprüfst du, ob umgesetzte Verbesserungen nachhaltig wirken
Gemeinsam mit den operativen Teams in den Lagern definierst du relevante KPIs – abgestimmt auf die verfügbaren Daten und die jeweilige Führungsebene
Dashboards und Reports, die operative Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen unterstützen, entwickelst und pflegst du eigenständig
Datenanforderungen definierst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem zentralen Data Team und stellst sicher, dass die benötigten Daten in der richtigen Qualität verfügbar sind
Bei Lean-Verbesserungsevents unterstützt du das CI-Team mit gezielter Datenerhebung und -analyse – vor, während und nach dem Event
Dem CI-Team vermittelst du ein solides Datenverständnis – von den Grundlagen bis zum bewussten Umgang mit Datenqualität
Führungskräfte coachst du darin, relevante und korrekte Daten professionell für ihre täglichen Entscheidungen zu nutzen
Bestehende Vorgehensweisen hinterfragst du konstruktiv, bringst neue Ideen ein und prüfst den Nutzen neuer Technologien – einschliesslich AI-basierter Ansätze – für unsere Analysen und Prozesse




Deine Fähigkeiten




Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss einer ETH, Universität oder Fachhochschule im technischen, datenanalytischen oder wirtschaftsingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich – oder über gleichwertige relevante Berufserfahrung
Mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer analytischen Rolle bringst du mit, idealerweise im Logistik- oder Operations-Umfeld
Gute SQL-Kenntnisse ermöglichen dir die eigenständige Durchführung von Datenabfragen und -analysen; Python-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Dashboards und Reports mit Tableau oder vergleichbaren BI-Tools wie Power BI gehört zu deinem Profil
Process-Mining-Erfahrung ist ein klarer Vorteil; die Bereitschaft, dich schnell in unser internes Tool einzuarbeiten, setzen wir voraus
Mit der Entwicklung von Business Cases, Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen, ROI-Betrachtungen und datenbasierten Entscheidungsvorlagen bist du vertraut
Erfahrung mit Lean Management, Six Sigma oder anderen strukturierten Verbesserungsmethoden ist von Vorteil
Deutsch beherrschst du mindestens auf C1-Niveau. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie für technische Dokumentationen runden dein Profil ab
Die Bereitschaft, regelmässig an verschiedenen Lagerstandorten vor Ort zu sein, bringst du mit
Vertrauen durch konsistente und verlässliche Handlungen aufbauen
Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und Implementieren von Änderungen zur Steigerung der Produktivität und Effektivität




Warum startest du bei uns?




Werte statt Blabla: Kooperativ, innovativ, piratisch, eigenverantwortlich, ambitioniert – diese fünf Werte fordern wir alle und leben wir alle.
Mutig selbst denken: Wir ermutigen alle, selbst und aktiv mitzudenken. Und lieben es, wenn du noch dazu mutig, neu und anders denkst.
Unkompliziert: Wir vermeiden Unnötiges und fokussieren uns aufs Wichtige. Vom Meistern von Herausforderungen bis zum Feiern unserer Erfolge.
Flexibilität statt verbiegen: Jede Position auch im 80%-Pensum möglich.
Schnelles Wachstum: Bei uns wächst und entwickelst du dich laufend. Und erhältst 2000 EDU-Punkte pro Jahr für deine Weiterentwicklung, damit du nicht stehenbleibst.
Weitere Benefits: Profitiere von 25 Tagen Ferien, exklusiven Mitarbeiterpreisen im Shop, Handy-, Internet- und TV-Abos zum Firmentarif, gratis Parkplatz und weiteren Vorteilen




Diversität ist unsere Kultur.




Um das beste Team zu bilden, sind wir offen für Menschen jedes Hintergrunds. Das heisst: Bei uns haben alle die gleichen Chancen. Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, geschlechtliche Identität, sexuelle Orientierung und Alter spielen dabei keine Rolle. Denn Inklusion bedeutet für uns, dass jede/r willkommen und jeder Beitrag wertvoll ist.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Analyst based in Switzerland.

As a Product Analyst, you will transform complex product and user data into actionable insights that drive business growth and enhance customer experiences. Working at the intersection of analytics, product management, and business strategy, you will help optimize product performance across digital platforms through data-driven decision-making. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate new features, improve user journeys, and identify opportunities for increased engagement and revenue. This role offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning are highly valued. It is an excellent opportunity for an analytical professional looking to make a measurable impact on product strategy and performance.

Accountabilities


Analyze product performance and user behavior to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Define, monitor, and optimize key product metrics such as retention, conversion, lifetime value, revenue, and churn.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions to support informed decision-making across Product, Marketing, and Operations teams.
Conduct in-depth analyses of customer journeys, feature adoption, promotional initiatives, and overall product performance.
Partner with Product Managers to evaluate new releases, product enhancements, and A/B testing initiatives.
Identify friction points within the customer journey and recommend data-backed improvements.
Collaborate with data teams to ensure the quality, consistency, and availability of analytical data.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.
Support customer segmentation, personalization initiatives, and market research to improve user engagement and business outcomes.


Requirements


Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or in a similar analytical role within digital products.
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets.
Hands-on experience with business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent tools.
Solid understanding of product analytics, customer behavior analysis, experimentation, and A/B testing methodologies.
Experience with event-based analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools is an advantage.
Knowledge of digital product monetization models, customer lifecycle management, or online platform analytics is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and exceptional attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience with Python or statistical analysis tools is considered a plus.
Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a collaborative remote environment.


Benefits


Competitive compensation package.
Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
Flexible working hours to support work-life balance.
28 days of paid annual leave.
3 paid sick days without requiring a medical certificate.
Additional seniority leave based on tenure.
Birthday day off.
Career development opportunities and long-term professional growth.
Collaborative international team and supportive remote-first culture.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Associate, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Associate, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence to join our BI implementation team based in Stabio, Switzerland.




Let’s talk about the role!

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Associate to join our EMEA Business Intelligence team.




This role is ideal for someone with a foundational understanding of data analytics and business intelligence who is eager to grow their technical and functional skills in a collaborative environment. The successful candidate will support the maintenance and enhancement of Data & Analytics solutions while working closely with senior team members and business stakeholders.




How You Will Make A Difference

Support the development and maintenance of ETL processes using tools such as SAP BODS, SQL Server, and Visual Studio
Hands on SQL, SAP HANA, Databricks, Power BI, Genie AI, IBM Cognos
Help monitor and maintain existing data solutions and pipelines
Participate in the analysis of current BI and analytics platforms to identify improvement opportunities
Contribute to technical and functional documentation for Data initiatives and migration projects
Work with business users and technical teams to understand requirements and support the delivery of BI solutions
Monitor scheduled jobs and escalate issues when necessary
Support implementation and adoption of Data AI solutions
Support cloud migration initiatives




Skills For Success

Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Familiarity with data warehousing and ETL concepts
Exposure to SAP HANA, SAP BODS, SQL Server, Databricks, Power BI or similar technologies is considered a plus
Familiarity with Cognitive AI concept and products
Ability to document processes and technical solutions clearly and accurately
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to understand business processes and translate business requirements into scalable technology and data solutions
Good attention to detail and willingness to learn new technologies
Effective communication, teamwork and proactiveness skills
English fluency, both written and spoken, is mandatory




Preferred Qualifications

Academic background in scientific or quantitative disciplines is mandatory
Up to 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field, preferably within multinational and international business environments.
Experience through internships, academic projects, or professional roles involving data analysis or reporting
Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Agile methodology




About VF

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com




What’s In It For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together
Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization
On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives
A discount card with 50% on all VF brands
Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks




Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join us as our new Data Analyst / Business Intelligence

Mission Summary

The Data Analyst supports Gold Avenue's Head of Business Intelligence in keeping the company's data and reporting accurate, consistent and accessible. The role covers data quality checks, tracking maintenance, pipeline monitoring, and maintains the KPIs, dashboards and analytical models that power weekly, monthly and executive reporting. It also serves as a first point of contact for cross-team data requests, helping other departments get, understand and act on the data they need.

Your mission

Data quality & tracking support


Data quality checks: Run routine checks to catch and flag discrepancies between tools, escalating issues that need deeper fixes.
Tracking maintenance: Help maintain tracking standards and naming conventions across Mixpanel, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, keeping the tracking white book up to date.
Pipeline support: Help run and monitor the existing data transformation pipelines (SQL), with senior support on more complex changes.
BI evolution: Contribute to the ongoing Looker Studio to Tableau migration, rebuilding data connections and dashboards alongside the Head of BI.
Roadmap Contribution: Contribute quarterly to BI/data roadmap prioritisation and process/tooling improvements.
Integration Management: Support third-party data integrations, tracking and pipeline adjustments during IT system changes.


Performance Reporting & Analysis


KPI Reporting: Prepare and update the KPIs for the Weekly Business Meeting.
Dashboard maintenance: Keep existing dashboards current and accurate, and help build new views as needs arise.
(CRO) Funnel and conversion analysis. Support CVR and funnel tracking by market and segment, monitor drop-off rates, and report on A/B test results and conversion uplift
Analytical modelling support: Support and maintain the analytical models (LTV, retention cohorts, ROAS) under the guidance of the Head of BI.
Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Support Head of BI in forecast and trend analysis for planning and target-setting


Data Service Center & Cross-team Support


Data Request handling: Act as a first point of contact for cross-department data requests, resolving straightforward tickets and escalating complex ones.
Ad-hoc analysis. Assist teams with queries, attribution questions and deep-dive analyses.
Self-service enablement: Help & empower teams to read and interpret dashboards on their own through documentation and informal training, reducing ad-hoc requests over time.
Stakeholder partnership: Build strong working relationships with Marketing, CRM and Product to anticipate data needs.


Your Skills

Languages & Experience


Native-level French and English.
Bachelor degree in IT/Business/Finance or equivalent
1 to 3 years in a data or analytics role, or a strong graduate with relevant internships and project work.


Technical


Solid SQL and a working understanding of how databases and data warehouses are structured.
Some Python for data transformation and automation, or a clear willingness to grow it.
Exposure to BI tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) and an appetite to develop dashboard skills.
Basic understanding of key ecommerce performance metrics and web tracking tools.
Comfortable in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite.


Behavioral


Attention to detail, with care for data quality, consistency and clean documentation.
Curiosity about ecommerce, growth and conversion metrics, and how data drives business impact.
Clear communicator who can explain findings simply to non-technical audiences.
Proactive and willing to learn, comfortable working with guidance rather than fully alone.
Collaborative across Marketing, Product and CRM teams.


Tools


SQL, Python, Excel / Google Suite, Mixpanel, Tableau / Looker Studio, Google Analytics (GA4), Kochava, Google Tag Manager, Claude AI, Slack

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Business Analyst (Commercial & Finance)



Our client is seeking a commercially minded Business Analyst to support strategic decision-making across a regional organisation. Working closely with Finance, Sales and Operations, you will turn data into actionable business insights, support financial planning activities and help drive business growth through informed decision-making.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with commercial awareness and enjoys partnering with stakeholders across the business to solve complex challenges.



Responsibilities


Analyse commercial, financial and operational performance across the region.
Develop business cases to support strategic investments and growth initiatives.
Support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities.
Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities and risks.
Partner with Sales teams to understand performance drivers and identify improvement opportunities.
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Extract, structure and analyse data from ERP and business intelligence platforms.
Produce management reporting and dashboards using BI tools such as Power BI, Qlik Sense or Tableau.
Support ERP transformation projects, including system upgrades and migrations.
Participate in data integration and EDI-related projects with external partners and suppliers.
Challenge assumptions, improve processes and identify opportunities for efficiency gains.
Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.


Requirements


Experience in Business Analysis, Commercial Analytics, FP&A, Business Intelligence or a similar analytical role.
Strong financial and commercial acumen with the ability to build business cases and support strategic decision-making.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience working with SAP or a similar ERP system.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI, Qlik Sense or Tableau is preferred.
Exposure to SAP S/4HANA migrations, ERP transformations or EDI integration projects would be advantageous.
Fluent English,German and French are essential; Italian would be a strong plus.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Finance, Sales and Operations.
Quick learner with a proactive, commercially minded and solution-oriented approach.
Comfortable challenging assumptions and providing data-driven recommendations.
Motivated to contribute to long-term business growth and performance.

Please note, only those shortlisted will be contacted and only those with the right to work in Switzerland will be considered.

Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Industrial / Supply Chain), you will be:


Understanding Industrial / Supply Chain business challenges and translating them into structured functional requirements
Gathering, analysing, and prioritising requirements through stakeholder workshops, and producing detailed functional specifications for BI & Analytics solutions
Defining data models and business objects with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, applying dimensional modeling (star schema, facts, dimensions, KPIs, semantic models)
Supporting UAT, validation, and ensuring business requirements are met throughout delivery
Upholding data governance, business rules, documentation, and data-quality standards, and driving user adoption of BI/Data best practices


Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:


6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Business Analysis. The ideal candidate now has a role of Project Manager / Delivery Coordinator.
Experience on Industrial / Supply Chain / Manufacturing projects is a must.
Experience with modern analytics platforms such as Power BI, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data platforms
Good understanding of dimensional data modeling and BI semantic models / analytical reporting platforms
Fluent French (mandatory) and a good professional level of English
Based in or able to work on-site in Barcelona from the beginning of September
Nice to have: experience in the watchmaking / luxury manufacturing industry

A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind

Title: Junior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
About Hilo By Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18 million deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, our vision is a world where no lives are lost or damaged from the effects of high blood pressure, and our mission is to build the technology that helps people control it.

We are a venture-backed scale-up that has raised over $96M. Our technology, rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily life. It is CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device and was FDA-cleared in 2026 as the first cuffless OTC blood pressure monitor in the United States. We are remote-first, headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland.

Role Overview

Imagine using your data engineering skills to improve the way cardiovascular health is monitored and managed. Hilo by Aktiia is redefining blood pressure monitoring through AI-driven optical technology built on more than 20 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM). Their solution combines a wearable device (Hilo), a mobile app, and a cloud-based platform for healthcare professionals — empowering users and physicians with continuous, actionable insights into blood-pressure patterns. With more than 200,000 users, over $120M in funding, and a CE-certified medical device already available across several markets, Aktiia is continuing to scale its technology, product ecosystem, and international presence.

As Aktiia expands its data capabilities, we're looking for a Junior Data Engineer who will help scale a Databricks-based medallion Lakehouse from a primarily R&D/Core Tech setup into a broader company-wide data platform. Working closely with and learning directly from an experienced Senior Data Engineer, you will support the ingestion, centralization, documentation, and validation of clinical, legacy, and operational data. Your work will help transform complex and sometimes messy data sources into clean, reliable, and model-ready pipelines used by Data Science, ML, Algorithm, and Core Tech teams.

Your Tasks


Data Ingestion & Lakehouse Development: Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and processing pipelines within Aktiia's Databricks-hosted medallion Lakehouse, working under senior guidance while gradually taking on more ownership
Clinical & Legacy Data Integration: Take an active role in ingesting, centralizing, and documenting clinical data currently spread across EDC platforms such as Castor and RedCap, databases, standalone archives, and other historically grown sources
Data Exploration & Practical Data Archaeology: Work hands-on with unfamiliar and sometimes messy datasets, identify structures and inconsistencies, and turn unstructured situations into reliable, usable data assets
Pipeline Development & Preprocessing: Build preprocessing and ETL/ELT pipelines that provide clean, structured, and model-ready datasets for Algorithm Development, Core Tech, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams
Data Quality, Validation & Documentation: Define and apply practical standards for data quality, validation, traceability, and documentation — especially for sensitive and clinically relevant datasets
Observability & Engineering Practices: Implement logging, validation checks, alerting, and basic observability for new pipelines, while contributing to shared codebase practices such as Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and testing
Platform Scaling & Collaboration: Support the evolution of the lakehouse from selected technical use cases toward a company-wide data infrastructure, working closely with the Senior Data Engineer, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders


Requirements


Academic Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Professional Expertise: At least 1+ year of practical post-study experience in data engineering, data infrastructure, data ingestion, or a similar hands-on technical role. You may still be early in your career, but you have already worked with real data pipelines, production-oriented data workflows, or collaborative data platforms
Technical Experience: You have solid hands-on experience with Python and SQL and bring practical experience with Databricks. You are familiar with cloud environments — ideally AWS. You understand the basics of ETL/ELT pipeline design, data ingestion patterns, and data modelling, and you have worked with shared codebases using Git, code reviews, CI/CD, or testing practices. Experience with Spark, Delta Lake, or Parquet is a strong plus
Industry Fit: Ideally, you have gained experience in a start-up, scale-up, or technically demanding environment where you worked hands-on across the data pipeline. Exposure to regulated or data-sensitive industries such as MedTech, Pharma, FinTech, or healthcare is a plus, especially when it comes to data quality, validation, and documentation
Language Skills: English at a highly proficient level is a must. French is advantageous
Personality: A curious, pragmatic, and hands-on problem-solver, you enjoy bringing structure into complex data environments. You work independently, ask the right questions, stay well organized, and collaborate openly with Data Engineering, Data Science, ML, Algorithm, Core Tech, and Product stakeholders. You are based in Switzerland and are comfortable working in a hybrid setup with one day per week regular presence in Neuchâtel


We're looking for a pragmatic, hands-on data builder who enjoys working with real-world clinical and company data — someone who is excited to bring structure into scattered datasets, build reliable pipelines, and help create a modern data foundation for advanced ML and digital health applications.

Do you want to grow your expertise in Data Engineering and cloud-based lakehouse architectures while contributing to health technology that has a direct impact on hundreds of thousands of people? Then we're excited to meet you!

Benefits

Why Join Us?


Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
Competitive compensation and other benefits (depending on location)

Title: Data Analyst for Beam Instrumentation (SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP)
Description:
Job Description

As an experienced Data Analyst with a solid background in physics, you will join the team responsible for the LHC Longitudinal Density Monitor (commonly known as the BSRL: Beam Synchrotron Radiation Longitudinal monitor) within the Beam Instrumentation Group.

In this role, you will lead the work on the online and offline data processing pipelines, which are fully implemented in Python. The analysis results from this instrument are mission-critical, directly impacting the calibration of the LHC experiments, facilitating the troubleshooting of operational issues, and enabling detailed beam physics analysis.

Additionally, you will play an important role in R&D and optimisation, conducting advanced studies to shape the upcoming upgrades of the BSRL instrument.

Your Responsibilities


Lead the redesign and optimisation of the current online and offline Python data analysis software for the BSRL instrument to ensure scalability, performance and reproducibility.
Develop specialised offline analysis routines using BSRL data, cross-correlating with other beam instrumentation where necessary, to meet the requirements of stakeholders.
Extend the online and offline diagnostics tools, architecting automated notification systems to detect early signs of instrument degradation, anomalies, or malfunctions.
Design and implement the specific software tools, calibration routines, and data pipelines required for the rapid commissioning of the renovated system after the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3).
Contribute to the validation and performance verification of the associated upgraded hardware planned for deployment during LS3.
Evaluate and benchmark different upgrade scenarios for LS3 by combining advanced data analysis of historical run data with physics-based simulation techniques.


Your profile


Proven background in the advanced analysis of complex experimental data, preferably from physics or large-scale scientific installations.
Extensive experience in software development with a strong emphasis on clean, maintainable code.
Basic experience in Monte Carlo-based physics simulation techniques.
Basic experience with laboratory work.


Skills


In-depth knowledge of advanced statistical methods, data modelling, and data analysis techniques applied to scientific datasets.
Proven proficiency in Python, including familiarity with the standard scientific stack (such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, etc) for high-performance processing.
Knowledge of version control systems (Git/Gilab) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
Basic knowledge of photon counting techniques would be advantage.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:


You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Data Analytics (or a related field) and have either:
a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.


Additional Information

Job closing date: 24.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-December-2026

This position involves:


Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP

Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics

Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits


A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
On-the-job and formal training including language classes.


Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

More information about us, here: careers.cern

Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Poste: Bienne




Contrat: Contrat à durée indéterminée avec Alten Suisse.




Nous recherchons un(e) Analyste de données pour rejoindre un environnement industriel à forte exigence qualité et contribuer à la fiabilisation, à l’analyse et à l’optimisation des données de référence. Véritable interface entre les opérations et les systèmes d’information, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la cohérence des données, l’amélioration continue des processus et le succès des projets de transformation.




Responsabilités :




Assurer la création, la mise à jour et le nettoyage des données de référence en garantissant leur cohérence et leur intégrité
Veiller à l’alignement entre les données présentes dans les systèmes d’information et la réalité du terrain
Analyser la qualité des données, identifier les écarts et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires
Participer activement aux initiatives d’amélioration continue visant à renforcer la fiabilité et la stabilité des données
Contribuer à la définition et à la maintenance des standards liés aux temps opératoires et aux données industrielles associées
Réaliser les analyses et chiffrages nécessaires à la gestion des temps de production et assurer la saisie des informations de référence
Accompagner les projets de migration et de transformation des systèmes en garantissant la conformité et la qualité des données
Apporter un support aux équipes métiers en traitant les anomalies, investigations et demandes opérationnelles
Collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un contexte transverse et multidisciplinaire

Formation technique supérieure (ES, CFC complété par une spécialisation, ou équivalent)
Expérience significative dans l’analyse, la gestion ou la gouvernance des données au sein d’un environnement industriel
Excellente compréhension des données techniques et industrielles telles que les nomenclatures, gammes, coûts de fabrication ou données d’assemblage
Bonne maîtrise des systèmes ERP, idéalement SAP, ainsi que des solutions PLM

Solides capacités d’analyse et aptitude à structurer des informations complexes
Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et approche méthodique
Français courant

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
La Fondation IPT, créée en 1972 par des entrepreneurs, est une fondation de droit privé, d’utilité publique et sans but lucratif. Elle est active dans l’insertion, la réinsertion et l’orientation professionnelle et travaille, en tant que partenaire national, avec les assurances sociales publiques ou privées, les entreprises, les institutions et les médecins.




Diversité et inclusion sont au cœur de notre mission. Nous encourageons chacun·e à réaliser son potentiel.




Afin d’accompagner l’évolution de nos outils et pratiques de travail, nous créons un nouveau poste au sein de notre équipe informatique basée à la Direction générale à Vevey, de :




Data Analyst (80-100%)




Nous recherchons une personne capable d’exploiter, d’analyser et de valoriser les données issues de nos systèmes actuels afin de répondre aux besoins de pilotage, de suivi et de reporting de la Fondation. Le poste sera centré sur l’extraction de données et la mise à disposition de reportings à partir de nos systèmes actuels. En parallèle, nous menons une réflexion sur l’évolution de nos outils et de nos pratiques en matière de données. Le ou la Data Analyst prendra ainsi une part active à cette transformation, avec l’opportunité de contribuer aux choix, aux améliorations et au développement des futurs outils de pilotage.




Ta mission :




Transformer les données opérationnelles liées aux prestations métier en informations fiables et exploitables
Assurer la qualité, la cohérence et l'exploitabilité des données opérationnelles
Produire et mettre à disposition des Directions cantonales les extractions de données nécessaires à leurs analyses et reportings
Soutenir les services supports de la Direction générale en matière de traitement de données, indicateurs et reportings
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord et reportings adaptés aux besoins des utilisateur·trice·s
Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration et contribuer à l’optimisation des processus




Ton profil :




Formation supérieure en informatique de gestion, data analytics, statistiques, mathématiques, économie d'entreprise ou domaine similaire
Connaissances des bases de données relationnelles (idéalement SQL), d'outils de reporting et de visualisation de données (p.ex. Power BI) et maitrise d'Excel
Maîtrise d’environnements digitaux et collaboratifs (p. ex. Microsoft 365, SharePoint, ERP, GED)
Première expérience en data analyse appréciée, mais pas indispensable si tu as les compétences clés
Véritable intérêt pour l’analyse de données, avec un esprit analytique développé et une curiosité naturelle pour comprendre ce que révèlent les données
Aisance relationnelle et capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés
Rigueur, esprit de synthèse et exigence de qualité dans les livrables




Nous t’offrons :




La possibilité de mettre à profit et de développer vos compétences au sein d’une entreprise engagée
Un poste à forte autonomie, des systèmes informatiques sains sur des équipements modernes et en constante évolution
Un environnement de travail bienveillant, aligné sur les valeurs de la Fondation
Une culture d'écoute et de valorisation des idées et initiatives
Une grande autonomie de travail, un horaire flexible et la possibilité de télétravailler
Un lieu de travail proche des transports public (bus, train)




Intéressé·e à nous rejoindre ?




Partagez-nous ton dossier de candidature complet par e-mail à : candidatures@fondation-ipt.ch en mentionnant dans l’objet de l’email « IPT DG – Data Analyst ».




Délai de candidature : 2 août 2026

Title: Analytics & Business Operations Associate
Description:
About Viscadia

Viscadia is a consulting firm whose mission is to empower life sciences companies with clarity and confidence through forecasting. With offices in the United States, Switzerland, and India, we are well-equipped to provide the support that global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies need to make decisions quickly and with confidence. We are deeply committed to a vision of shared growth and success for our clients, colleagues, and communities.




Role Overview

The Analytics and Business Operations Associate will support the Viscadia's European and global needs across three areas: Global analytics and project delivery, business development and marketing support, and day-to-day Swiss business operations. Primary responsibilities may vary based on business priorities, but are expected to be approximately:

Global analytics & project delivery: ~50%
Business development & marketing support: ~30%
Swiss business operations: ~20%




Based in Lucerne, this is a broad, hands-on role for a professional who combines strong analytical ability with a proactive, well-organized approach. The incumbent will support global life sciences consulting engagements across forecasting and commercial insights while helping build and operate Viscadia's growing European presence. As part of a lean and growing Swiss team, this role suits a proactive, hands-on go-getter who takes ownership, is comfortable wearing multiple hats, and thrives with limited oversight in a fast-moving environment.




This position reports directly to the Associate Principal based in Lucerne, who leads Viscadia's presence in the region.




Key Responsibilities:




Global Analytics & Project Delivery

Work as part of active client engagement teams, supporting the development and maintenance of forecasting and analytics models for client engagements, including data gathering, structuring, and quality checks.
Conduct secondary research and synthesize insights on therapeutic areas, disease states, treatment paradigms, competitive landscapes, and pharmaceutical market dynamics into clear, actionable summaries.
Build and format analyses, charts, and presentations that translate findings into clear, evidence-based narratives for client and internal audiences.
Support engagement managers and senior leadership on project tasks, ensuring accuracy, thoroughness, and on-time delivery.
Collaborate with global delivery teams in the United States and India across time zones to provide seamless, round-the-clock client support.




Business Development & Marketing Support

Research pharmaceutical companies, therapeutic areas, licensing opportunities and strategic accounts to support business development initiatives across Europe.
Support the preparation of proposals, pitch materials, case studies, and capability demonstrations.
Maintain CRM records and track the pipeline of leads, opportunities, and follow-ups.
Support marketing activities, including content, collateral, conference planning and execution, LinkedIn and digital presence, and webinar coordination.
Help organize client meetings, conferences, and regional networking activities.




Operations & Administration

Coordinate and support the day-to-day operations of the Swiss office, ensuring efficient and reliable running.
Support compliance, documentation, and coordination with local authorities and service providers.
Maintain organized records and support scheduling, travel, and general administrative needs.
Liaise with banks, accountants, legal counsel, government authorities, immigration partners and other external service providers.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Life Sciences, Data Analytics or a related quantitative field.
Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Life Sciences, Data Analytics or a related quantitative field will be preferred.
1-3 years of relevant experience in consulting, analytics, forecasting, pharma or life sciences, data, or related environments. Internship experience is valued.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Working familiarity with Python, SQL, VBA, dashboarding tools, or analytics platforms is preferred.
Exposure to generative AI and productivity tools to improve research, analysis, presentation development and operational efficiency.
Interest in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, forecasting, analytics, or consulting environments.
Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex analyses clearly.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while demonstrating initiative and ownership.
Self-starter with a strong work ethic, curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to learn.
German is advantageous but not required for local business development and administration.
Authorized to work in Switzerland requiring no visa sponsorships.




Employment Terms

Location: Lucerne, Switzerland (On-site with hybrid working arrangement with an expectation of 3 days regular presence in office).
Part-time 75%, with the possibility of increasing to 100% subject to business needs and individual performance.
Occasional travel within Europe to support client meetings, conferences and business development activities.




Why Join Viscadia?

A high-impact, intellectually stimulating environment with direct exposure to senior leadership and global life sciences clients.
Gain exposure to forecasting, commercial strategy, business development, and Swiss business operations.
Develop consulting, analytics, and client-facing skills in a high-growth environment.
Competitive compensation complemented by performance-based recognition that rewards excellence, innovation, and ownership
Global exposure and a collaborative culture, working with cross-functional teams across the United States, Switzerland, and India
Structured opportunities to grow across analytics, commercial, and operations, with a clear pathway to broaden scope and responsibility over time.




Viscadia is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Specialist (M/F)
Description:
We are opening a position for a Data Analyst / Data Specialist (M/F) to strengthen a team committed to a high-level medical research program, based in Nyon. This role is part of a multidisciplinary environment combining data, science, and health, with a focus on structuring and advanced data exploitation in a demanding and evolving context.



Position Responsibilities

Analyze and exploit structured datasets, including longitudinal and potentially medical or sports data

Participate in structuring, validating, and documenting data (rules, definitions, quality)

Contribute to analytical projects related to research and innovation activities

Identify methodological limitations and propose improvements in data usage

Collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to popularize analytical issues and results

Intervene in the development and improvement of platforms or tools related to data management

Monitor multiple projects in parallel with an organized and rigorous approach

Gradually support activities as an autonomous reference on data issues

Job requirements

Degree in data science, statistics, computer science, or equivalent field

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, data management, or research support

Good understanding of complex data (health, sports, or longitudinal data is an asset)

Developed analytical mindset with the ability to assess data quality and relevance

Proficiency in at least one analytical language or tool (R, Python, SQL, SPSS, or equivalent)

Comfortable with Microsoft office tools, especially Excel

Ability to work in a team while gradually gaining autonomy

Proficiency in written and spoken English (French and/or German is an advantage)

💼 Continuous training: A training budget that increases every month, with access to a wide range of courses

🏝 25 days of paid leave: All our employees are entitled to 25 days of paid vacation per year

🚑 International accident insurance coverage

🎉 Regular events: Monthly gatherings to connect in both small and larger groups

🌍 International environments: Opportunities to work on projects within large international organizations

🛠 Innovation: Contribute to impactful and innovative projects across various industries

🎁 Little perks: Our employees benefit from an attractive perks and discount program

Contribuer aux réflexions stratégiques Data & BI (Data Mesh, Data Products, transition depuis Synapse/Databricks vers Fabric).

Solide maîtrise de l'écosystème Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory, Synapse Data Engineering).
Maîtrise de SQL avancé, Python / PySpark et DAX.
Expérience avérée sur le format Delta Lake et l'architecture Lakehouse.
Expertise sur l'écosystème Microsoft Cloud : Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics.
Maîtrise des pratiques DevOps et CI/CD (Azure DevOps, gestion du versionning Fabric Git Integration / Deployment Pipelines).
Connaissance de Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) un plus.
Expérience de migration depuis des environnements traditionnels (SQL Server, SSIS) ou Cloud (Databricks, Snowflake) vers Fabric.
Certification Microsoft appréciée (DP-600 : Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate ou DP-700).

Expérience confirmée d'au moins 4 à 5 ans dans le domaine de la Data / BI Cloud.
Expérience significative en conseil, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer un projet et faire le pont entre la technique et le métier.
Pédagogue, capable d'animer des ateliers, de former des équipes et d'incarner l'expertise Fabric auprès des décideurs.

Engageons la conversation ! Pour commencer, nous souhaitons découvrir qui vous êtes : votre parcours, vos intérêts et vos aspirations. Cette première prise de contact nous permettra de mieux vous connaître.

Title: Finance Data & Reporting Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Introduction

CordenPharma is a leading full-service Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, drug products (DP), and packaging. With around 3,000 employees worldwide, we help pharmaceutical and biotech companies manufacture medicines with the ultimate goal of improving people’s lives.

Our network, spanning Europe and the US, provides flexible and specialized solutions across six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules, and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to delivering the highest quality products for patient well-being.

Our People Vision

We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients' lives.

What you can expect

Shape the Future of Finance with Data & AI

At CordenPharma, we are driving the transformation of Finance into a data-driven, AI-enabled function. As part of our Group-wide Lighthouse Project, we are building modern reporting, analytics, and automation capabilities that enable faster decisions, greater transparency, and improved business performance. To support this journey, we are looking for a Finance Data & Reporting Analyst who combines financial understanding with a passion for data, analytics, and AI-powered solutions.

Your Opportunity

In this role, you will help build and own the Finance data and reporting infrastructure that serves as the foundation for decision-making across the Group. You will automate reporting processes using Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, and AI-driven workflows while supporting FP&A and Finance Business Partners with meaningful insights and management reporting.

Strategic Responsibilities


Support the Finance transformation roadmap as part of the Lighthouse Project.
Build and continuously improve the Finance data foundation and reporting landscape.
Drive automation of manual reporting processes using Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, and AI solutions.
Contribute to the development of scalable and self-service reporting capabilities across the organization.


Operational Responsibilities


Develop and maintain management reports, dashboards, and analytical tools.
Support FP&A and Finance Business Partners with reporting, analysis, and performance insights.
Build and optimize Power BI data models and dashboards.
Support the development of the Finance data lake and reporting infrastructure.
Improve data quality, standardization, and reporting efficiency across Finance


To successfully master this role, we are looking for the following qualifications:


Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Data Analytics, or a similar role.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, including building data models and dashboards from scratch.
Interest in AI, automation, and digital finance transformation.
Strong understanding of financial concepts such as P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Fluent English; German or French is an advantage.


What we offer

Above average pension fund benefits / we cover 70% of the contributions.

Above average social insurance contribution

Employee Events

Hybrid working opportunities

Interested?

If you enjoy working in a team and are interested in a varied area of responsibility, if you think and act beyond your own area of responsibility, then you should join our team.

Do you require more information?

In case of questions to your application, the position or something else I am very happy to support you.

Mirjam Engel

Talent Acquisition Manager

E-Mail: bewerbung.cpi@cordenpharma.com

Title: Analytics Engineering Advocate
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytics Engineering Advocate based in Switzerland.

This role is designed for a technically skilled and customer-focused professional who is passionate about helping teams succeed with data.

You will combine analytics engineering expertise, problem-solving skills, and strong communication abilities to support users and communities.

The position offers the opportunity to work closely with modern data teams, helping them adopt best practices and unlock the value of their analytics workflows.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, bridging user needs, product improvements, and community engagement.

Working in a fully remote environment, you will contribute to an open and collaborative culture built around transparency and shared knowledge.

You will also play a key role in exploring AI-powered workflows and helping others leverage emerging technologies effectively.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will become a technical advocate for analytics engineering practices, supporting users, sharing knowledge, and helping shape better data experiences. You will collaborate with customers, communities, and internal teams to solve complex challenges, improve adoption, and contribute to the evolution of data workflows.


Support users through technical troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving via communication channels, calls, and collaborative sessions.
Provide guidance on analytics engineering best practices, SQL development, data modeling, and modern data workflows.
Become a subject matter expert on the platform, understanding product capabilities and helping users maximize its value.
Create educational resources such as tutorials, documentation, guides, demos, blog posts, videos, and code examples.
Build and nurture a strong analytics engineering community by engaging users, identifying advocates, and encouraging knowledge sharing.
Represent the product and community at events, conferences, and meetups while sharing insights about modern analytics and AI-driven workflows.
Use AI-powered tools to improve productivity, accelerate technical problem-solving, and help users adopt similar approaches.
Gather user feedback and translate insights into recommendations that support product strategy and continuous improvement.


Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in analytics engineering with excellent communication skills and a passion for helping others succeed with data.


Hands-on experience with dbt, SQL, data modeling, and modern data stack technologies.
Strong understanding of business intelligence, analytics engineering workflows, and data team practices.
Comfortable working with Git, command line tools, and data visualization platforms.
Experience using AI coding assistants and productivity tools to accelerate development, debugging, and problem-solving.
Ability to navigate complex technical challenges with curiosity, resilience, and a structured approach.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences.
Natural teaching ability and experience creating educational content, documentation, or technical enablement materials.
Strong empathy, active listening skills, and a user-focused mindset.
Ability to connect user challenges with product opportunities and strategic improvements.
Comfortable working in a remote environment across time zones, ideally within UTC +/- 3 hours.


Benefits


Competitive compensation package: £65K - £100K.
Equity opportunity ranging from 0.1% - 0.3%.
Fully remote working environment with flexibility to work from different locations.
Opportunity to contribute to an open-source product used by modern data teams.
High-impact role combining technical expertise, customer success, community building, and product influence.
Collaborative culture focused on transparency, autonomy, and shared decision-making.
Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-powered workflows and modern analytics practices.
Inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.
Continuous opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to the future of data and analytics.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR).
