Title: Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Finance)
Description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Finance), you will be:


Understanding Finance business challenges and translating them into structured functional requirements
Gathering, analysing, and prioritising requirements through stakeholder workshops, and producing detailed functional specifications for BI & Analytics solutions
Defining data models and business objects with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, applying dimensional modeling (star schema, facts, dimensions, KPIs, semantic models)
Supporting UAT, validation, and ensuring business requirements are met throughout delivery
Upholding data governance, business rules, documentation, and data-quality standards, and driving user adoption of BI/Data best practices


Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:


6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Business Analysis. The ideal candidate now has a role of Project Manager / Delivery Coordinator.
Experience on Finance projects is a must
Experience with modern analytics platforms such as Power BI, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data platforms
Good understanding of dimensional data modeling and BI semantic models / analytical reporting platforms
Fluent French (mandatory) and a good professional level of English
Based in or able to work on-site in Barcelona from the beginning of September
Nice to have: experience in the watchmaking / luxury manufacturing industry


Benefits

What we offer


A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset


Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

Title: Junior Data Engineer
Description:
Created 12 years ago, NEXUS Automotive International (NAI) is the global leading intermediary company between manufacturers (>100), leading distributors of the independent automotive aftermarket worldwide (>500), and workshops (>5000) in the automotive aftermarket. NEXUS Automotive International is managing consolidated sales above 50 billion €.




Mission Summary




Type of contract: permanent - full-time




Mission: Participate in the NEXUS data initiative by collecting product reference data from our partners, transforming and enriching data, to support the development of tailored data service to the NEXUS community and to boost added value for all.




Key responsibilities




Initial AI Calibration for onboarding. Set up initial AI recipe to enable partner data onboarding jointly with business experts.
Service provider coordination. Run tech committee with service provider regularly, Track SLA (mapping precision >95%, timeliness). Escalate gaps to the tech lead.
Mapping exceptions. Handle ~500-800 exceptions/month: new products, taxonomic ambiguities, obsolete references.
Data pipeline monitoring. HubSpot → AWS → Snowflake. Detect anomalies (volumes, formats, latencies). Weekly report to the steerco.
Pipeline evolution. Contribute to pipeline improvements with the data engineering team. Python for business transformations, Snowflake SQL for analysis.
BI services support. Share of Wallet, price alerts, sectoral dashboard: aggregate quality, k-anonymity, query performance. Daily contact with the data product owner.




Required skills / Experience / Qualification




Engineering degree (HES, EPF). Specialization in data, computer science, or information systems or related field.
0-2 years’ experience.
SQL knowledge
Python knowledge




We don't expect deep expertise in everything. We expect someone who codes Python, understands SQL, isn't afraid of AWS, and learns the rest fast. Curiosity and resourcefulness matter more than years of experience.




Desired skills




Git
AWS
Snowflake
Project management




At Nexus Automotive International, we are driven by our core values of Agility, Entrepreneurship, and Innovation. We believe that these principles empower us to excel in a fast-paced industry and drive meaningful impact for our partners and communities worldwide.




We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone can thrive, bringing their unique perspectives and talents to the table. Join us at Nexus, where people are at the heart of our mission, and let’s shape the future of the automotive aftermarket together.

Apply today and be part of our journey!

If this procedure does not lead to your engagement, the company hereby undertakes to destroy the data or if you so request, to return your file to you.

Data Modelling & Business Analysis

Translate business concepts into scalable, well-structured transformation pipelines and analytical models.

3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Excellent English communication skills; proactive, collaborative, and self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Title: Data Engineer (Palantir)
Description:
Who we are




SII Group is a trusted technology partner, SII provides high value added solutions for the IT projects of many large corporations. Since its founding in 1979, the Company has been providing solutions adapted to its clients’ needs, by relying on :




> Its acknowledged expertise in various industries and sectors

> Proven 'turnkey' solutions

> An efficient quality system

> Adaptable, evolving services




Today, with a staff of more than 18'000, SII Group is supporting companies across 20 countries.




At SII Switzerland we pay attention to the personal and professional wellbeing of our employees. We place our collaborators at the heart of our actions and activities. If you are motivated by the perspective of joining a big, trusted and recognized group, then let's meet !




To develop our consulting offer and support one of our clients, we are looking for a talented Data Engineer (Palantir).




Missions

Build Pipelines in Foundry: You develop and scale data pipelines (ETL/ELT) directly within Palantir Foundry (e.g., via Code Repositories, Pipeline Builder) and integrate data from a wide variety of source systems.
Data Modeling & Ontology: You help map our data into the Foundry Ontology, making complex business logic tangible and accessible for analysts and end-users.
Data Quality & Lineage: You implement health checks, monitor data quality across the entire data lineage process, and ensure that pipelines run stably.
Code & Transformation: You write clean, efficient code (primarily in PySpark and SQL) to clean and transform large volumes of data.
Team Collaboration: You work closely with Data Scientists, Analysts, and business departments to translate their requirements into functioning data models within Foundry.




Profile

Initial professional experience in Data Engineering (as a Junior, e.g., through relevant internships/working student roles; as a Mid-Level, approx. 1–3 years in a permanent role).
Good to excellent knowledge of Python (ideally experience with PySpark or Pandas) and are highly proficient in SQL.
Prior experience with Foundry (e.g., Contour, Code Repositories, Ontology) is a massive plus. If not: You have a strong foundation in data processing and are highly motivated to dive deep into the Palantir ecosystem.
Solid basic understanding of relational databases, data architectures, and the challenges of working with distributed systems (Big Data).
Solution-oriented, think analytically, and enjoy diving into complex datasets and learning new tools.




For information

Start date : September
Location : Zurich - CH
Duration : permanent contract
Language : fluent in English, German is a plus

Title: Senior Business/Data Modelling Analyst
Description:
The client is building a new Data Warehouse / Data Intelligence Hub for their Asset Management division. Data has already been migrated and the technical foundation is in place.

The mandate has arisen due to internal resource reallocation during budget delays, and an external expert is now required to drive data modelling activities. This position requires a senior profile with strong business analysis, data analysis, and data modelling capabilities.

The successful candidate will help shape the data warehouse, connect existing datasets, and coach internal team members.




Key Responsibilities

* Lead the creation and optimisation of data models for the Data Warehouse / Data Intelligence Hub.

* Conduct business analysis to gather requirements from Asset Management stakeholders.

* Perform data analysis to validate data quality, relationships, and modelling decisions.

* Build conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

* Create and validate Power BI reports to demonstrate data availability and correctness.

* Collaborate with data engineers, business teams, and technical stakeholders.

* Guide and coach the internal team in data modelling best practices.

* Ensure the data warehouse structure is scalable and strategically aligned.

* Connect already migrated datasets to make them usable for analytics and reporting.




Desired Skills and Experience

* Minimum 5+ years in Business Analysis and Data Modelling.

* Strong technical background; experience in data engineering preferred.

* Strong understanding of data warehousing and modelling processes.

* Experience with Power BI (building reports, validating data structures).

* Ability to shape the data warehouse and work independently.

* Asset Management experience beneficial but not required.

* Certifications not required (but a plus).







Experience within Insurance/Financial Services is mandatory

Job Description

Job Title: Document Reviewer

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Carefully review large volumes of structured and unstructured data, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Identify and flag issues related to data quality, consistency, and potential risks involving Personal Identifiable Information (PII).

Familiarity with handling and protecting Personal Identifiable Information (PII).
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings and communicate effectively with team members.
Demonstrated ability to follow complex guidelines and adhere to established taxonomies.
Experience performing QA or validation work on large data sets.
Ability to balance efficiency with precision in a remote work environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Background in legal, compliance, privacy, auditing, compliance or information security domains.
Prior experience supporting data-driven AI or machine learning projects.
Comfort with collaboration tools and digital workflow management platforms.

Title: Business Transformation Specialist - Data & Analytics

For over 150 years, our dedication to being the Global Hausbank for our clients has been driven by our people – in around 60 countries and across more than 150 nationalities.

Their deep understanding, insights, expertise, and passion help our clients navigate an increasingly complex world – be it in our Corporate Bank, our Private Bank, our Investment Bank or our Asset Management division. Together we can make a great impact for our clients at home and abroad, securing their lasting success and financial security.

In this role, you will support Data & Analytics initiatives within Private Bank Switzerland, acting as both Business Analyst and Project Manager across reporting, data quality, regulatory and remediation topics.

Drive Data & Analytics projects across three locations as Business Analyst and Project Manager, liaising with requestors, business stakeholders and IT delivery teams.
Understand data requirements from a content perspective, drive data discovery and analytics, and work with IT colleagues to create reports and interfaces.

Create audit-ready documentation in collaboration with the IT delivery team.
Design appropriate data quality controls and ensure their implementation.
Analyze reported issues in databases and source systems, including erroneous or missing data, to identify functional problems and data gaps.



Skills


Experience in project management across business and technical environments.
Good knowledge of private banking products, services and processes, ideally within Wealth Management.
Proven expertise in core banking platforms, preferably Avaloq, from a business or functional perspective.
Intermediate knowledge of database querying with SQL.
Solid understanding of data analysis and technical concepts related to data warehousing.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Emotionally and mentally balanced

We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.

Physically thriving

We support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive.

Socially connected

We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.

We support you to meet personal financial goals during your active career and for the future.

Title: IT Industrial Business Analyst (BI & Data)
Description:
Ivy Partners est une société de conseil suisse qui accompagne les entreprises dans leurs défis stratégiques, technologiques et organisationnels.




Nous avons à cœur d’offrir à nos collaborateurs une carrière qui favorise leur épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nous les accompagnons dans leur montée en compétences et leur ouvrons de réelles perspectives d’évolution.




En tant que IT Industrial Business Analyst (BI & Data) chez Ivy Partners, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes:

Compréhension des besoins métier

Animer des ateliers avec les équipes métiers afin de comprendre, formaliser et prioriser leurs besoins en matière de reporting, d'analyse et de pilotage industriel.
Définir une vision commune des processus, des indicateurs, des KPI et des règles de gestion.
Analyser les processus industriels afin d'identifier les opportunités d'amélioration, de standardisation et d'optimisation des usages de la donnée.

Analyse fonctionnelle

Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées des solutions de Business Intelligence.
Définir les règles de gestion, les dimensions analytiques et les KPI nécessaires à la construction des tableaux de bord.
Accompagner les équipes projet lors des phases de développement, de validation et de recette.

Data & Business Intelligence

Collaborer avec les Data Engineers et Analytics Engineers pour concevoir les modèles de données.
Participer à la définition des objets métiers de référence et des spécifications de modélisation.
Contribuer à la conception et à l'évolution des modèles sémantiques afin de garantir une lecture homogène des données.

Gouvernance & Adoption

Participer aux activités de Data Governance (documentation, référentiels, règles métier, qualité des données).
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption des nouvelles solutions BI.
Assurer une documentation fonctionnelle claire garantissant la pérennité et la traçabilité des solutions.




Vous êtes notre candidat(e) idéal(e) si :

Vous avez entre 8 et 10 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la Business Intelligence ou de l'analyse fonctionnelle.
Une expérience sur un ou plusieurs domaines industriels est indispensable :WMS ou PLM ou MES
Vous maîtrisez les plateformes analytiques modernes telles que Power BI, Databricks, dbt ou autres environnements de data cloud.




Pourquoi rejoindre Ivy Partners ?




Bienveillance | Soucieux de nos employés, nous leur garantissons un environnement favorable où chacun est valorisé et soutenu avec des formations et de réelles perspectives d’évolution.




Confiance | Nous avons à cœur de bâtir des relations solides et durables avec nos clients. Travailler avec nous, c’est développer un partenariat fondé sur la confiance, le professionnalisme et la transparence à chaque instant.




Innovation | Nous allions technologie et créativité pour mener à bien des transformations numériques à fort impact.




Responsabilité | La collectivité est à la base de tout ce que nous entreprenons, et nous prenons cette responsabilité au sérieux en mettant tout en œuvre pour avoir un impact positif.

Title: Data & Reporting Specialist 80-100% (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir bewegen und begeistern Menschen. Einfach. Nachhaltig. Voraus.

Mit über 90 Standorten schweizweit steht die AMAG Retail in direktem Endkundenkontakt und umfasst alle AMAG Garagenbetriebe, Carosserie Center und Occassions Center.

Du bist die Brücke zwischen Daten und Entscheidungen.

Als Reporting & Power BI Specialist verwandelst du Daten aus SAP, CRM und Microsoft Fabric in klare, verlässliche Reports für Controlling, Sales, Aftersales, Finance und Marketing.

Du bist dabei nicht nur Entwickler/-in, sondern Data Storyteller und strategische/-r Partner/-in der Fachbereiche.

Wie wir dich begeistern


Life long learning: Wir beteiligen uns an deiner Weiterbildung – booste deine Karriere!
Flexibilität leben: Vereinbare Familie, Hobby und Beruf – geniesse die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens
ZIF: Zusätzliche individuelle Freitage – Kaufe dir zusätzliche Urlaubstage und gönne dir eine wohlverdiente längere Auszeit
Ganzheitliches Mobilitätskonzept: Parkhaus, Car-Sharing und eine E-Bike-Flotte – alles, was du für deinen Weg zur Arbeit brauchst
Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service: Für dich und deine Familie – weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst


End‑to‑End Reporting: Du konzipierst, entwickelst und deployest Power‑BI‑Reports und Dashboards über den gesamten Reporting‑Lifecycle hinweg und stellst deren nachhaltigen Betrieb sicher
Business Partnering: Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen Controlling, Sales, Aftersales, Marketing und Finance zusammen, nimmst Anforderungen auf und übersetzt diese in tragfähige Reporting‑ und Analytics‑Lösungen
Data Storytelling & Analytics: Du verwandelst komplexe Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in klare, verständliche Insights, identifizierst relevante Geschäftsfragestellungen und leitest datenbasierte Optimierungspotenziale ab
Governance & Qualität: Du stellst eine hohe Daten‑ und Reporting‑Qualität sicher, definierst und etablierst Standards, verantwortest die Dokumentation sowie die Versions‑ und Deployment‑Prozesse
Enablement & Zusammenarbeit: Du befähigst Key User zu Self‑Service BI (inkl. Power BI und Copilot) und förderst die effiziente Zusammenarbeit zwischen internen und externen Partnern


Das bringst du mit


Aus- und Weiterbildung: Technische oder kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch Studium/Weiterbildung in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder BWL
Berufserfahrung & Business-Verständnis: Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Finanz‑/Controlling‑Umfeld, idealerweise mit Projekterfahrung und Branchenkenntnissen
Daten‑ & BI‑Expertise: Fundierte Erfahrung in Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric sowie in der strukturierten Datenaufbereitung
Technische Skills: Sehr gute SQL‑Kenntnisse (z. B. Azure SQL, Fabric Warehouse, SAP‑Extrakte) und solides technisches Verständnis

Title: Data Engineer (H/F)
Description:
Chez 𝗖𝗕𝗧𝗪 (Collaboration Betters The World), entreprise mondiale de conseil en technologie, la collaboration est la pierre angulaire de l’innovation et du succès, et le fondement de tout ce que nous mettons en œuvre.

Notre mission : transformer les entreprises et les communautés pour un monde meilleur.

Présents dans plus de 20 pays et 35 villes, nous allions une expertise mondiale avec une compréhension locale des enjeux de nos clients.




Au sein de la Service Line "Data Analytics & IA", nous développons une approche qui vise à accompagner nos clients dans la définition de leurs stratégies en matière de Data Science et d’IA, d’Analytics et Business Intelligence, de Data et plateformes. L’objectif est de les accompagner à chaque étape de leurs parcours afin de les aider à libérer le potentiel de leurs données.




Que vas-tu faire ?




Concrètement au sein de l'expertise Data Engineering, tu seras en charge de :




1. Conception & Architecture

Concevoir des architectures Data scalables et sécurisées : Data Lake, Data Warehouse.
Réaliser des estimations de coûts et comparer objectivement différentes technologies et architectures.
Participer aux choix technologiques en fonction des enjeux métiers et contraintes techniques.
Définir et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie et d’architecture Data.




2. Développement & Industrialisation

Construire et industrialiser des pipelines batch et temps réel.
Implémenter des pratiques CI/CD, observabilité, gouvernance et data quality.







Quel est ton profil ?




Tu as une expérience significative de plus de 7 ans en data engineering.
Tu es issu d’une formation dans le domaine de la Data niveau Bac +5/Ecole d'ingénieur
Tu détiens une expertise sur une Data Platform moderne idéalement Data Bricks ou Microsoft Fabric
Tu maîtrises un cloud public (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
Tu as de très bonnes compétences en SQL et Python.
Tu disposes de solides connaissances en architecture Data moderne.
Tu as une forte aisance relationnelle notamment pour l'animation d'atelier variés (conception, ateliers agiles, retros et cadrages).




Notre processus de recrutement :

1ère étape : Rencontre avec un membre de l’équipe RH pour introduire le poste, l’environnement de travail et comprendre tes motivations ;

2ème étape : Rencontre avec les équipes de la Service Line pour faire connaissance mais aussi te challenger techniquement ;

3ème étape : Rencontre avec un membre de la direction et l’un de nos sales pour te challenger sur ta compréhension de CBTW, le partage de valeurs communes et ta motivation pour nous rejoindre.




Ce que nous te proposons :

Collaborer au sein d'une entreprise internationale dynamique et ouverte d'esprit où tes idées sont entendues et valorisées ;
Accéder à des perspectives d’évolution professionnelle tout au long de ta carrière via des formations et des certifications ;
Bénéficier d'un suivi de carrière sur mesure avec ton référent RH et des points réguliers avec ton Business Manager lors de tes missions ;
Intégrer des communautés te permettant de partager des centres d'intérêts communs ou expertises techniques ;
Créer du lien avec des collaborateurs passionnés à travers différents évènements internes (afterworks, soirées annuelles, séminaires, …).




Nous avons hâte d'échanger avec toi !

Title: Business Analyst / Consultant - Artificial Intelligence & Data - (AI & Insights)
Description:
Job Description

Location: Zurich, Geneva

Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices

Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyze growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making.

We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward.

This role is open to candidates with either an AI/Analytics or a Data Engineering/Data Platform background and preference. During the interview process, we will determine the best fit for you within one of these specialized subteams.

We also welcome applications from trainee candidates with limited work experience, provided they are available for full-time work (not returning to school). After 4–6 months in a trainee role, we will reassess readiness for a Business Analyst role.

For this role, we are currently offering start dates from February 2026.

How You Can Make An Impact


Design and implement AI and data strategies and modern solutions – including data management, platforms and AI use cases – that enable clients to achieve their business objectives across regulatory, cost and revenue pillars.
Provide architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership to guide complex data and AI transformations with significant organizational implications.
Drive Data & AI use cases from business value concept to production.
Build and maintain trusted client relationships through project delivery and business development, expanding your network internally and externally.
Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
Continuously grow your knowledge across industries and share insights with Deloitte talent.



Who We Are Looking For

Drive and Motivation:


Passionate individuals eager to build a career in AI & Data Consulting.
Strong drive to learn, master new topics and manage multiple activities independently in a fast-paced environment.



Consulting and Communication Skills:


Strong writing and Microsoft Power Point skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
Business-IT Translator: Ability to act as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions.
Attention to detail and ability to communicate technical specifics clearly in both written and oral forms.



Technical expertise:


First practical experience with AI & analytics solutions is highly recommended.
Familiarity with SQL and Python is a plus.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, including working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and related services is a plus.
Knowledge of data platforms tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku) and data visualisation tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) is a plus.
Strong engineering or mathematics background is advantageous.



Language Proficiency:


Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders.



Industry Experience:


First relevant experience in consulting, tech companies, or industry-specific roles, particularly in AI & data-driven fields.
Previous experience in the Banking, Insurance, Life Science or Healthcare sector is advantageous.



Your team

Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich or Geneva offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities.

Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want.

We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries.

Life at Deloitte

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.

In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.

Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch .

How To Apply

We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates.

If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch


We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today.

Title: Internship Data Product Value Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
As part of the Global Data Governance team, this role has the unique opportunity to shape the future of data products and data valuation at Liebherr. The goal will be to support the development of the data product foundation and build a standardized and scalable data value framework – focusing on identifying, evaluating, and maximizing the business impact of data-driven use cases across divisions.
We are looking for a graduate student (or soon-to-graduate) who is interested in learning on the job and contributing to the fascinating topic of data product & value management. This is a temporary engagement with a duration of 12 months.

Responsibilities:
Global Data Governance

Explore the role of data governance within the Liebherr Group, i.e., goals, scope, responsibilities, operating model, communities etc.
Align the activities around data product & value management with Liebherr’s global data strategy


Data Products

Learn about data products, what it means and how it fits into Liebherr
Support the creation and implementation of the global data product framework
Co-facilitate and contribute to the cross-divisional expert group on data products
Support the onboarding & piloting of the data product concept within divisions
Move from concept to reality, i.e., train stakeholders to build and manage data products
Assist in documentation and communication activities


Data Value

Identify and estimate business impact of data-driven use cases
Support the application and optimization of the data value approach
Contribute to the standardization of templates, metrics, and valuation logic
Automate the use-case documentation and valuation process
Develop dashboards and reports for value tracking
Scale the valuation approach across the entire company



Competencies:

Strong analytical and structured thinking skills
Proactiveness and diligence in problem-solving
Impeccable communication and storytelling abilities
Advanced Excel skills (modelling, calculations)
Fluency in English, French or German would be an asset.
Experience with Power BI and Databricks or similar tools is a plus
Experience with prompting and building AI agents is a plus
Prior understanding of master data management, SAP MDG or practical experience with data & analytics governance topics would be an asset
Hands‑on mentality with a strong willingness to learn and explore new topics
Enjoys collaborating in an international environment


Our offer:

A unique opportunity to gain practical experience in a strategic data governance environment of a globally operating company
Exposure to enterprise‑scale data platforms and governance frameworks
On‑the‑job training with experts in data governance, data engineering, analytics, and compliance
Hybrid work model and modern working environment in Bulle (Fribourg region)
Benefits of a stable and globally established family-owned company

Title: Corporate Real Estate Analyst
Description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data analyses, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that property decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights.

The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, creating dashboards in Power BI, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders.

We offer flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with time spent in the office.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information
Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team
Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users
Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner
Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data
Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control
Raise purchase orders and verify invoices
Prepare presentation materials, data analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools
Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting
Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division’s intranet presence
Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities


Your background


Proven experience in real estate data management, data analytics, and reporting
Experience in lease management
Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function
Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data
Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform
Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset
Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment



More About Us

Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams.

The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified:


Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary
Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico


The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.

Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:


Competitive salary and incentives
Well-being and care
Paid and unpaid leave
Flexible work options
Benefits that support your financial security


You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

Please note that only candidates with a valid work permit and legal authorization to work in the respective hiring country will be considered.

Title: Ingénieur de données/Ingénieure de données
Description:
CLEEVEN est un cabinet de conseil européen fondé autour de deux convictions fondamentales :

L'excellence des ingénieurs européens doit être un moteur de la compétitivité mondiale
Notre mission humaine : accompagner nos consultants dans leur développement personnel et professionnel

Présent en Suisse, nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs projets de transformation digitale et de valorisation de la donnée.




Contexte du projet :

Nous recherchons un Data Analyst / BI Engineer pour accompagner le développement et l'évolution de solutions de reporting et d'analyse décisionnelle.

Vous interviendrez au croisement des enjeux métiers et techniques afin de transformer des données complexes en indicateurs de pilotage et en outils d'aide à la décision. Vous participerez à l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée : compréhension des besoins, modélisation, construction de tableaux de bord et amélioration continue des solutions analytiques.




Objectifs du projet :

Recueillir et analyser les besoins de reporting et d'analyse des équipes métiers.
Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et solutions de reporting.
Extraire, transformer et analyser des données provenant de multiples sources.
Construire et faire évoluer des modèles de données et des couches sémantiques.
Définir et suivre des KPIs permettant de piloter l'activité.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données.
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'exploitation des outils décisionnels.
Participer à l'amélioration continue de l'écosystème BI et Data de l'entreprise.




Compétences clés :

Solides compétences en SQL et en bases de données relationnelles.
Expérience sur des outils de Business Intelligence et de visualisation de données.
Bonne maîtrise des concepts de modélisation de données.
Capacité à traduire des besoins métiers en solutions de reporting concrètes.
Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
Aisance dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel.

Nice To Have

Expérience avec Looker et/ou LookML.
Expérience avec Power BI, Tableau ou des outils similaires.
Connaissances des concepts ETL/ELT et des pipelines de données.
Expérience sur des plateformes cloud (GCP, Azure ou AWS).
Expérience dans un environnement industriel ou manufacturier.
Connaissances de Python pour l'analyse de données ou l'automatisation.




Profil recherché :

Formation supérieure en informatique, data, systèmes d'information, mathématiques, statistiques ou ingénierie.
Expérience en tant que Data Analyst, BI Engineer ou sur un poste similaire.
Forte capacité d'analyse et sens du détail.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers et à transformer les données en informations exploitables.




À très vite !

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Notre mission




Ivy Partners est une société de conseil suisse qui accompagne les entreprises dans leurs défis stratégiques, technologiques et organisationnels.




Nous avons à cœur d’offrir à nos collaborateurs une carrière qui favorise leur épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nous les accompagnons dans leur montée en compétences et leur ouvrons de réelles perspectives d’évolution.




En tant que Data Engineer chez Ivy Partners, vous serez amené(e) à :

- Réaliser des modèles sémantiques et des dashboards dans Power BI.

- Former et aider les data analysts au quotidien afin de les rendre autonomes dans la réalisation de dashboards complexes sur Power BI.

- Collecter, préparer, nettoyer et structurer les données issues de différentes sources internes et externes.

- Construire et maintenir des modèles de données robustes et optimisés (Snowflake, Datamarts Power BI).

- Assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la gouvernance des données (validation, règles métier, dictionnaire de données).

- Concevoir et développer des rapports, tableaux de bord et visualisations interactives sous Power BI.

- Maîtriser et écrire des scripts DAX avancés (mesures complexes, optimisation de performance, calculs dynamiques).

- Gérer la publication et la sécurité dans l’environnement Power BI Service (workspaces, RLS/OLS, refresh scheduling).

- Optimiser les performances des rapports et des datasets (meilleures pratiques, monitoring, capacity planning).

- Former et coacher les utilisateurs internes sur Power BI.

- Participer à l’évolution de l’architecture BI et aux initiatives de modernisation (data lake, automatisation, gouvernance).




À propos de vous

Vous êtes notre candidat(e) idéal(e) si :

- Vous possédez une excellente maîtrise de Power BI et de Fabric, avec une expérience prouvée dans la réalisation rapide de nombreux dashboards complexes.

- Vous comprenez et pouvez utiliser Fabric au quotidien (développement, data engineering, reporting, etc.).

- Vous avez des connaissances de Tableau.

- Vous êtes pédagogue, capable d'expliquer et de faire du support auprès des autres data analysts.

- Vous maîtrisez le français et avez une excellente communication orale et écrite, claire, précise et adaptée à l’audience.

Title: Data Analyst for Beam Instrumentation (SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP)
Description:
Job Details

Job Description

As an experienced Data Analyst with a solid background in physics, you will join the team responsible for the LHC Longitudinal Density Monitor (commonly known as the BSRL: Beam Synchrotron Radiation Longitudinal monitor) within the Beam Instrumentation Group.

In this role, you will lead the work on the online and offline data processing pipelines, which are fully implemented in Python. The analysis results from this instrument are mission-critical, directly impacting the calibration of the LHC experiments, facilitating the troubleshooting of operational issues, and enabling detailed beam physics analysis.

Additionally, you will play an important role in R&D and optimisation, conducting advanced studies to shape the upcoming upgrades of the BSRL instrument.

Your Responsibilities


Lead the redesign and optimisation of the current online and offline Python data analysis software for the BSRL instrument to ensure scalability, performance and reproducibility.
Develop specialised offline analysis routines using BSRL data, cross-correlating with other beam instrumentation where necessary, to meet the requirements of stakeholders.
Extend the online and offline diagnostics tools, architecting automated notification systems to detect early signs of instrument degradation, anomalies, or malfunctions.
Design and implement the specific software tools, calibration routines, and data pipelines required for the rapid commissioning of the renovated system after the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3).
Contribute to the validation and performance verification of the associated upgraded hardware planned for deployment during LS3.
Evaluate and benchmark different upgrade scenarios for LS3 by combining advanced data analysis of historical run data with physics-based simulation techniques.


Your profile


Proven background in the advanced analysis of complex experimental data, preferably from physics or large-scale scientific installations.
Extensive experience in software development with a strong emphasis on clean, maintainable code.
Basic experience in Monte Carlo-based physics simulation techniques.
Basic experience with laboratory work.


Skills


In-depth knowledge of advanced statistical methods, data modelling, and data analysis techniques applied to scientific datasets.
Proven proficiency in Python, including familiarity with the standard scientific stack (such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, etc) for high-performance processing.
Knowledge of version control systems (Git/Gilab) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
Basic knowledge of photon counting techniques would be advantage.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility Criteria


You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Data Analytics (or a related field) and have either:
a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Additional Information

Job closing date: 24.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-December-2026

This Position Involves


Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP

Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics

Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits


A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
On-the-job and formal training including language classes.


Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

More information about us, here: careers.cern

Title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant H/F (Geneva)
Description:
fifty-five is a new kind of data company that helps brands transform with data and AI to improve their marketing operations through a combination of specialized consultancy and technology services.

As the strategic data pillar of The Brandtech Group, we offer services that combine strategy consulting, cloud services, media consulting and customer experience.

We are made up of over +320 digital experts. Digital consultants, tracking and media specialists, engineers and data scientists all work in close collaboration to provide senior-level marketing consultancy and technical support to our clients, in every type of industry, all around the world.

As a partner to advertisers from data collection to activation and exploitation, we help organizations become truly omnichannel entities that control the efficiency of their digital ecosystem and its synergies with the physical world.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

Within the consulting team based in Geneva, you will actively take part in delivering fifty-five's data-led projects to multiple clients. Those projects will be driven by client objectives relating to data collection, customer acquisition, onsite conversion optimisation, media-mix optimisation and digital business consulting. During these projects, you will contribute to promoting a customer-centred vision of digital marketing, based on the systematic and methodical use of data to support decisions. You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.


You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.


You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Based on your good understanding of our projects and our clients' needs, you will collaborate with all our teams to develop fifty-five's offer, both in terms of marketing and in terms of technical and operational delivery.



Responsibilities


Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)


Education and Experience


Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
1 to 3 years experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media

Skills and Interests


Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding
Client-facing skills
Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Title: Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern
Description:
MAIN PURPOSE

The Group Sustainability team has progressed with the consolidation and integration of its Non-Financial Reporting Framework, specifically building on the Swiss Non-Financial Reporting requirements. Looking ahead, the fast-moving Non-Financial Reporting landscape, driven by a growing number of regulatory requirements, entails the ongoing enhancement of non-financial reporting processes. In this context, the Sustainability Transformation team's primary objectives are to oversee the Non-Financial Reporting Framework, and support the continuous improvement of the Group Sustainability Framework.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES

The Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern will assume a key role in the following areas:


Provide assistance in the continuous improvement of the Richemont Non-Financial Reporting Framework, ensuring alignment with the GRI and other relevant Standards;
Support the ESRS gap assessment and the formalisation of improvement plans;
Support the critical review of GRI disclosures and the ongoing update of required documentation (e.g. GRI Index; Basis of Preparation);
Support the critical review of regulatory requirements (e.g. CSRD), including benchmark analysis;
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting;
Support the team in collecting, analysing non-financial information (e.g. content collection template update), conducting data quality check to ensure accuracy and completeness of non-financial reporting;
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools, including digital solutions.


Skills


Excellent written and verbal communication
Self-motivated, strong work ethic, very strong organisational skills
Proven ability to meet deadlines and work on multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent attention to detail, thoroughness
Ability to anticipate needs by being proactive not reactive
A first experience within the luxury industry is an asset
Keen interest and understanding of sustainability topics
Ability to work cross-functionally and build relationships in the Group


PROFILE


Previous first experience in corporate sustainability preferred
Master degree in Sustainability, Economics or related field
Knowledge of GRI, CSRD, ESRS, EU Taxonomy
Detailed oriented and analytical
Fluent in English required, good knowledge of French preferred
Proactive and flexible
Good command of Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, Word
Good communication skills
Experience working in multi-stakeholder initiatives, whether at University or other

We are currently recruiting gig-workers across multiple countries to support a global AI training data project.




The task is simple: capture photos of everyday objects at home and upload them to our platform.




No professional photography experience is required.




💰 Compensation

Earn $0.28 per approved image

Typical contributors upload 100–500 images, allowing you to earn $30–$140 per session depending on participation.

Take clear photos of common objects around you
Upload them with the object name and image details(Dropdowns)
Follow simple submission guidelines

We are collecting images across many real-world product categories, including:

This is a large-scale international project, with each country contributing 4,000 – 16,000 images.

We are looking for hundreds of contributors globally.




👤 Ideal For

Freelancers
Students
Gig workers
Remote workers
Anyone looking for flexible side income

**Spots are limited per country, so early registration is recommended.

Title: Business/Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Ekkiden ist eine in 2019 gegründete internationale Beratungsgruppe: sie vereint ein Ökosystem leidenschaftlicher und engagierter Beraterinnen und Berater, die Transformationsprojekte in den Bereichen Organisation, Operations und Technologie durchführen, insbesondere in IT/Digital, Industrie/F&E sowie Nachhaltigkeit, für Großunternehmen und KMU in Frankreich, der Schweiz, Spanien und Deutschland.

Über die Rolle

Als Business Analyst und/oder Data Analyst übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, Data/BI und IT. Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, definierst Kennzahlen und Berichte und trägst so massgeblich zu datenbasierten Entscheidungen und zur Optimierung der Geschäftsabläufe bei.

Aufgaben


Aufnahme, Analyse und Strukturierung von fachlichen und datenbezogenen Anforderungen aus den Business Units
Analyse und Dokumentation von Geschäftsprozessen sowie der zugrunde liegenden Datenflüsse und Systeme.
Durchführung von Datenanalysen und Auswertungen (z. B. in Excel oder BI-Tools) zur Unterstützung von Management-Entscheidungen.
Definition von KPIs, Reports und Dashboards in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Data/BI-Teams.
Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen und User Stories für datengetriebene Lösungen (Reporting, Analytics, Automatisierung).
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Data Engineers und BI-Spezialisten bei der Umsetzung der Anforderungen in Datenmodelle und Berichte.
Kontinuierliche Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in Prozessen, Datenqualität und Transparenz.
Strukturierte Dokumentation von fachlichen Anforderungen, Prozessen und relevanten Datenstrukturen.


Must-have


Mehrjährige Erfahrung (5+) als Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im datengetriebenen Umfeld
Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis.
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Daten und Reporting (z. B. Excel, SQL-Grundlagen oder gängige BI-Tools z.B. Power BI)
Erfahrung in der Aufnahme und Dokumentation von Anforderungen (z. B. mittels Use Cases, User Stories, Fachkonzepten).

Title: Data Analyst – Cloud Migration & BigQuery
Description:
Descrizione Del Lavoro

Our organization is launching a strategic initiative to migrate its data infrastructure from an on-premise Oracle Database environment to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The project involves consolidating legacy data warehouses, re-architecting ETL/ELT pipelines, and adopting cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow.

The selected Data Analyst will be a key contributor across every phase of the migration lifecycle: from as-is data analysis of source systems, through post-migration validation, to supporting business teams in their transition to new cloud-based analytics tools

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Mapping


Inventory and document Oracle source data (schemas, tables, stored procedures, views)
Perform data profiling to identify anomalies, duplicates, and inconsistencies
Define logical data mappings from Oracle to BigQuery for each data domain
Collaborate with data engineers on the definition of transformation rules


Validation & Quality Assurance


Design and implement data reconciliation tests for pre- and post-migration phases
Develop SQL / BigQuery SQL queries to compare source and target datasets
Produce data quality reports covering completeness, accuracy, and consistency metrics
Log and track data anomalies using issue-tracking tools
Strong data modeling skills, including conceptual, logical, and physical design, with hands-on experience in normalization and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).﻿


Migration Support ﻿


Actively participate in sprint planning and stand-ups with technical and business teams
Support the migration of legacy reports into GCP-native tools (Looker, Looker Studio)
Contribute to the definition of data governance standards and cloud best practices
Document data transformation processes for knowledge transfer purposes


Personal Profile & Soft Skills﻿


Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Ability to communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders
Operational autonomy and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Good time management in multi-task and project-driven environments
Team player: comfortable working in cross-functional IT/Business teams
Flexibility and adaptability in contexts of technological change
Language: Italian Native or Bilingual
Language: English (written and spoken, minimum B2 level)


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Specialization courses in data engineering, cloud computing, or analytics are a plus

Title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst (EU Remote), SEAR
Description:
Summary
As part of our efforts to protect our users, Apple is looking for a world-class senior threat intelligence analyst to join a team of security researchers and threat intelligence analysts. This team works together and cross-functionally to drive efforts to solve security engineering challenges, with an emphasis on supporting decisions that provide the greatest long-term security. The success we are striving for is the result of very skilled people working in an environment that cultivates creativity, partnership, and solving old problems in new ways. Protecting over a billion endpoints. Operationalizing security research and threat intelligence into security engineering decisions affecting every layer of the stack. Touching the lives of everyone who interacts with our products. Working for a company whose commitment to user privacy is at the heart of everything it does. Being surrounded by the most creative, passionate, hardworking engineers in the industry. Constantly being challenged to go beyond the norm to find new, innovative ways of solving problems and to make software safer, easier, and more fun to use. You can find all of this in one opportunity, and only at Apple.

Description
You will have a broad set of skills that make you successful as threats continue to evolve, capable of analyzing cyber threats to our users’ devices. Our environment fosters innovation, rapid solution development, and a liberating amount of autonomy. You will be expected to work with security engineers and researchers in order to quickly bring to market new security methods and technologies addressing the complex needs of mobile and distributed computing.

Responsibilities

Provide input into development of security technologies.
Analyze and understand advanced cyber actors, capabilities, and techniques.
Analyze and understand exploit development and proliferation.
Collaborate with security researchers to drive engineering solutions.
Work with security engineers in designing innovative mitigations to cyber threats while preserving privacy, ease-of-use, and user experience.
Work closely with external partners in support of cyber threat intelligence activities.
Remote work, with occasional travel.


Minimum Qualifications

In-depth understanding of the threat intelligence cycle and cyber operations.
Significant years of experience conducting threat research, preferably as a technical lead.
Experience in analyzing highly-complex threat actor campaigns, including infrastructure, malware, and victim endpoints.
Ability to distill complex problems into manageable tasks and then drive those tasks to completion.


Preferred Qualifications

Intellectually curious team player with a genuine passion for discovering, understanding, and mitigating cyber threats.
Some knowledge of iOS internals.
Impeccable attention to detail.
Growth mindset, thrives in fast-paced, changing environment.
Excellent communications skills (verbal and written).
Proven history of successfully working on solo and group projects (experience with virtual/remote collaboration is a plus).

Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Tasks and responsibilities




Procurement SME Support




Provide expert guidance on procurement documentation, contract structures, contract hierarchies, and contractual relationshipsServe as an escalation point for complex documentation and information requests
Perform independent validation and second-review assessments as required
Support the project in interpreting procurement-related information and identifying appropriate sources of evidence and documentation




Supply Contract Documentation Investigation




Support the identification, retrieval, and validation of contractual documentation and related procurement artefacts across multiple repositories and storage locations
Investigate missing, incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent supply contract records and metadata
Help reconstruct contract hierarchies and relationships where documentation is fragmented across multiple systems or repositories
Identify potentially missing contractual components such as annexes, addenda, amendments, change orders, statements of work, schedules, exhibits, and supporting documentation
Review contractual content to determine whether additional related documents or contractual artefacts should exist and require further investigation




Artefact Discovery and Information Analysis




Assist in locating procurement and supplier management artefacts within procurement domain, including: RFP documentation; Supplier screening records; Due diligence documentation; Approval records; Governance documentation; Sourcing event outputs; Contractual supporting documents; Supplier onboarding documentation; Procurement risk assessment artefacts
Analyse incoming information requests and determine the most appropriate investigation approach
Coordinate searches across multiple tools & systems, repositories, shared drives, SharePoint sites, email archives, and stakeholder groups
Validate findings and assess whether identified documents sufficiently address the original request or investigation objective




Data Quality and Metadata Assurance




Review contract-related metadata for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and regulatory reporting readiness
Support remediation activities to improve data quality across contract, supplier, and procurement repositories
Validate information before it is incorporated into central TPRM records and reporting processes
Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend corrective actions.
Contribute to the establishment of sustainable documentation and metadata quality standards




Stakeholder Coordination




Collaborate with Procurement Operations, Contract Repository Administrators, Sourcing Managers, Category Leads, Legal teams, and other Procurement and technical SMEs
Coordinate investigation activities required to close information gaps and resolve documentation issues
Help track outstanding issues, dependencies, and escalation items
Maintain effective communication with Procurement project coordinator and TPRM counterpart(s) as required
Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of assigned requests, investigations, tasks




Governance and Continuous Improvement




Participate in regular governance meetings supporting the overall remediation programme
Provide progress updates, issue summaries, risk assessments, and recommendations
Escalate topics requiring Procurement leadership review or decision-making
Identify opportunities to improve information traceability, documentation quality, repository structures, and overall remediation efficiency
Propose pragmatic process, governance, and data management improvements where systemic challenges are identified
Analytically support the development of sustainable target-state practices for contract and procurement information management




Must-have criteria




Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in: Business Administration; Supply Chain Management; Procurement; Economics; Information Management; Business Law; European Banking Regulations; Or a related discipline
Ability to understand and navigate commercial contract structures and associated documentation
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving mindset
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex and evolving environment
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
Excellent organisational, documentation, and prioritization skills
Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders
Ability to challenge assumptions, investigate inconsistencies, and drive issues to resolution
2–5 years of professional experience in multiple of the following areas: Procurement Operations; Contract Management; Contract Administration; Procurement Governance; Supplier Lifecycle Management; Procurement Data Management; Vendor Documentation Management; Procurement Excellence or Operations Support
Demonstrated experience working with: Commercial supply contracts for services; Supply contract repositories; Supply contract documentation structures; Supply contract metadata and records management
Strong understanding of contractual hierarchies and relationships, including: Master Agreements; Statements of Work; Amendments; Addenda; Annexes; Change Orders; Schedules and Exhibits
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Experience performing data quality reviews, information validation, and records remediation activities
Ability to analyse contractual documents and identify relationships between agreements and supporting artefacts
Proven ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and resolve complex information requests
Strong capability to work with large volumes of documentation while maintaining accuracy + attention to detail




Nice-to-have criteria




Experience within banking, financial services, insurance, or another highly regulated industry
Exposure to: Third Party Risk Management (TPRM); DORA; EU GDPR; Data protection law; Outsourcing governance; Regulatory reporting; Operational resilience programmes; Supply contract remediation programs
Experience with: Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems; Source-to-Pay systems; SharePoint; HCL Notes; ServiceNow; Procurement repositories; Supplier management platforms; Document management systems; Databases
Familiarity with metadata governance, master data management, and information lifecycle management concepts
Practical experience with databases, data extraction techniques, and cross-system record linkage concepts
Previous experience supporting remediation, regulatory readiness, governance, audit, or data quality programmes
Experience preparing materials and updates for governance forums, steering committees, senior stakeholder reviews
Ability to identify opportunities for process simplification, repository optimisation, and sustainable data quality improvements
Experience working in matrix organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

Until 31.12.2026 with option of extension

Title: Digital Services, Retail & CRM IT Business Analyst
Description:
Role Overview

Within Swiss Markets IT team, this role ensures the stability, quality, and continuous improvement of e‑Commerce, Retail, CRM and Digital solutions for the Region (Switzerland, India, Brazil, Mexico, LATAM).

The position has a strong Run, Support and Quality orientation, with significant responsibility on testing, coordination, incident and bug management, while also covering small to medium functional projects and evolutions in close collaboration with Business teams, Global IT, Markets, European IT and external partners.

The role sits at the crossroads of support, quality assurance, and project management and delivery, ensuring reliable day‑to‑day operations while supporting controlled evolutions of the digital ecosystem.

Key e-Commerce applications are SAP HYBRIS (e-Ccommerce Backoffice, migration planned), Adyen (PSP), Kibana/ELK (Monitoring), Commerce Tools (new eCommerce engine) and all systems linked to order fulfillment management.

Major Retail applications in the scope of this position are the ORACLE POS (ORION program), the Clienteling app (My Boutique App), the CRM ecosystem (around the Pioneer solution), Adyen, the after-sales solution (ACET), the traffic counting solutions (Tallyfi, Prodco), RFID, InChanel, MyInventory App, OAB solutions etc.

Key Responsibilities

Run, Stability & Quality



Guarantee the availability, performance, and quality of e‑Commerce, Boutique POS, Digital applications, CRM platforms and related services (web, OMS, payment, client services).
Coordinate run activities, incident management, and root cause analyses with global, regional, and local IT teams.
Monitor recurring issues and contribute to preventive and corrective action plans.



Support, Testing & Validation



Co‑lead testing activities in close and equal collaboration with the Digital and Division teams, with shared responsibility on quality and readiness.
Jointly define, plan, and coordinate testing activities (SIT, UAT, regression, non‑regression) for run topics and projects.
Ensure, together with Digital and Division teams, proper coverage of functional, integration, and end‑to‑end tests.
Collaborate on the validation of fixes, enhancements, and releases prior to production deployment.
Contribute with the Digital and Division teams to the continuous improvement of testing processes, documentation, and ways of working.



Project & Evolution Contribution



Lead or contribute to small and medium‑scale projects and functional evolutions related to e‑Commerce, Retail, Digital and CRM.
Coordinate the e-Commerce migration rollout with the Digital team, GDS (the Global team), and the local team (market).
Ensure quality, operational readiness, IT coherence, and smooth handover from project to run.
Participate in roadmap planning, taking into account operational constraints and dependencies.
Define and implement interfaces between various solutions in collaboration with the suppliers and internal or external partners. Carry out testing of solutions/upgrades/bug fixes, including interface testing.
Implement specific platforms (cash registers, mobility, electronic banking, etc.) according to business needs in collaboration with the European IT teams that develop most of the applications used for Boutiques in the Swiss Markets region.
Contribute to the monitoring and coordination of all tasks related to systems and technology aspects for the Boutique opening, renovation and relocation.



Coordination & Governance



Act as a key interface between Business, Markets, Global IT, Europe IT and external partners.
Organize and animate operational follow‑ups, workshops, and coordination meetings.
Maintain clear documentation and ensure compliance with IT governance, security, and audit standards.



What you will bring to the role



Education: 5 years of higher education in engineering .
Successful experience in e-Commerce, Retail and CRM fields (minimum 3 years), ideally in the Fashion or Luxury goods sector. 
IT knowledge: strong e-Commerce and CRM technical and functional expertise is mandatory:
Functional expertise of the e-Commerce journey (from browsing to order confirmation to reverse logistics). OMS & Fulfillment flows, payment flows and release management should have no secrets for you.
Salesforce for CRM is a plus; POS systems (such as ORACLE XSTORE & SIOCS or CEGID CBR-Y2) would be a plus; SQL queries, scripts, ETL, and web services would be a plus. Familiarity with RFID, boutique counting, queue management, OAB, etc.
Strong experience in run operations, testing coordination, and incident management.
Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders in an international and multicultural context.
Languages: Fluent French and English (Spanish, Portuguese, or German would be a plus) .

Role Overview

Within Swiss Markets IT team, this role ensures the stability, quality, and continuous improvement of e‑Commerce, Retail, CRM and Digital solutions for the Region (Switzerland, India, Brazil, Mexico, LATAM).

The position has a strong Run, Support and Quality orientation, with significant responsibility on testing, coordination, incident and bug management, while also covering small to medium functional projects and evolutions in close collaboration with Business teams, Global IT, Markets, European IT and external partners.

The role sits at the crossroads of support, quality assurance, and project management and delivery, ensuring reliable day‑to‑day operations while supporting controlled evolutions of the digital ecosystem.

Key e-Commerce applications are SAP HYBRIS (e-Ccommerce Backoffice, migration planned), Adyen (PSP), Kibana/ELK (Monitoring), Commerce Tools (new eCommerce engine) and all systems linked to order fulfillment management.

Major Retail applications in the scope of this position are the ORACLE POS (ORION program), the Clienteling app (My Boutique App), the CRM ecosystem (around the Pioneer solution), Adyen, the after-sales solution (ACET), the traffic counting solutions (Tallyfi, Prodco), RFID, InChanel, MyInventory App, OAB solutions etc.

Key Responsibilities

Run, Stability & Quality

Support, Testing & Validation

Your mission

You will work on different projects to help Astrafy customers get the most out of their data. You will work on the business and technical sides of the customer usecase, bridging the gap between raw cloud infrastructure and business-ready insights.

On the business side:


Architect Tailored Solutions: Translate client business goals into highly scalable, cost-efficient data platform designs combining Google Cloud’s power with open-source flexibility.
